input: Full-modulus IID covariant records from supplied native qutrits; correlated outcomes retained
primary_result: Exact label-only code lattice, paired metric, exact LLL/Babai repair shortlist and native-score training selection
proof_obligations: Systematic basis equals the full modular code lattice at unit rank
Paired metric and every unimodular transform are exact
Every Babai repair and full-root secret membership is independently replayed
Only training records select the candidate; fresh batch is acquired afterwards
Surrogate metric is not silently promoted to exact likelihood or a Gaussian promise
All original source and classical list costs, rank failures and misses remain visible
falsifiers: A decoded point leaves the actual full-root code
Hidden truth enters subset selection, lattice reduction or proposal ranking
A noise pair is treated as two independent originals
A candidate chosen after seeing fresh data inherits a one-candidate verifier
Failed bounded attacks are promoted to classical hardness
